cards.q: What is target leakage, and why does it inflate test scores?
cards.a: A feature carries information you would not have at prediction time, often because it is a consequence of the outcome. The model learns that shortcut, so test scores look great but the model fails in production.

cards.q: 2% of batches fail and a model always predicts 'passed'. What is its accuracy, and which metric exposes it?
cards.a: 98% accuracy, yet it catches zero failures. Recall on the failed class is 0, and a confusion matrix shows it too. Accuracy misleads on imbalanced data.

cards.q: When do you fit a StandardScaler relative to the train/test split, and why?
cards.a: Split first, then fit the scaler on the training set only and use it to transform both sets. Fitting on all the data leaks the test set's statistics into training. A scikit-learn Pipeline enforces this automatically.
